role: A falling sand, gravel, anvil or dragon egg: the block entity BlockFalling spawns when sand loses its support, which falls, lands as a block again or drops as an item.
scope_reason: Falling blocks are not switched off in world.conf (anvil itself is, but sand and gravel fall normally).
